name: two-snapshots-delete-one
notes: Two coexisting snapshots with different sizes and TTLs; deleting ONE ends only its own accrual, the other keeps accruing until its own confirmed delete. s1: 2048 B * 3000 ms = 6,144,000; s2: 4096 B * 7000 ms = 28,672,000 byte*ms.

name: empty-volume-zero-usage
notes: A provisioned volume of 0 bytes exists as a resource for 5000 ms but accrues exactly zero usage: 0 B * 5000 ms = 0. The totals row EXISTS (resource exists) with zero — it is not omitted and not fabricated.

name: three-resume-cycles-no-double-count
notes: Three suspend/resume cycles: each resume is a NEW runtime resource (new generation, new resource id), so per-generation accrual is 1000 milliCPU * 1000 ms = 1,000,000 each (r1, r2, r3) with no overlap and no double counting across generations. The workspace volume v1 accrues continuously through all suspends: 1024 B * 5000 ms = 5,120,000. The harness also replays the whole batch a second time and asserts duplicate receipts with identical totals.

name: volume-trashed-while-sandbox-active
notes: The volume is trashed at t3000 (retention window START, audit-only) and purged at t6000 while the sandbox runtime stays Active until t8000. Volume accrual runs 0..6000 (purge ends it, NOT the trash marker and NOT the runtime stop): 1024 B * 6000 ms = 6,144,000. Sandbox compute accrual continues past the purge to its own confirmed stop: 1000 milliCPU * 8000 ms = 8,000,000. Trash->purge is fully independent of sandbox resume/destroy.

name: snapshot-ttl-expired-delete-unconfirmed
notes: Snapshot TTL expires at t2000, which emits a delete REQUEST (snapshot.expired, audit-only); deletion is only confirmed at t6500. Accrual continues through the whole unconfirmed window: 2048 B * 6500 ms = 13,312,000 byte*ms — never 2048 * 2000. Both the retention deadline and the actual release time are recorded.

name: lost-correction-in-sealed-month
notes: Lost runtime: trusted heartbeat H=t1000, lease expired R=t3000 -> confirmed only 1000 milliCPU * 1000 ms = 1,000,000, plus an uncertain [1000,3000) gap of 2000 ms. The recovery produces a trusted late stop effective t2000, which lands INSIDE the sealed 2026-09 period [0,4000): apply_correction flags it for manual handling (flagged_manual) instead of auto-applying. Sealed-period totals are unchanged: still 1,000,000 (auto-applying would rewrite them to 2,000,000). The flagged correction is not stored in the event history.
